text:
'Milan, Real & Man Utd eye Napoli's McTominay' - gossip
- Published
AC Milan, Manchester United and Real Madrid are reportedly interested in Napoli's Scott McTominay, while it is claimed Celtic would be interested in Aston Villa's John McGinn.
AC Milan have identified Napoli and Scotland midfielder Scott McTominay as a top transfer target, with Real Madrid and Manchester United also interested in the 29-year-old. (Quotidiano Nazionale, external)
Celtic would be interested in making a move for John McGinn if the 32-year-old Scotland midfielder decides to leave Aston Villa and return to his homeland in the coming years, claims former senior Villa scout Bryan King. (Football Insider, external)
If Huracan do not take up their £1.6m option to buy Oscar Cortes when the 22-year-old winger's loan ends on 31 December, he will return to Rangers an improved player having already racked up 32 Argentine league appearances this year, scoring four times and adding five assists. (The Herald, external)
Rangers have already turned down big offers for winger Djeidi Gassama and have no intention of cashing in on the 23-year-old in January. (Football Insider, external)
Mikey Moore would be enjoying a more beneficial season if Tottenham Hotspur had sent the 19-year-old former Rangers loanee to Millwall rather than Cologne, former Spurts scout Bryan King has suggested. (Football Insider, external)
Chelsea, Newcastle United, Salzburg and Anderlecht are seriously interested in 17-year-old Heart of Midlothian winger Jaedon Donkor. (Rudy Galetti on X, external)
Hearts winger Rogers Mato wants to play in the Champions League and Premier League one day, but meantime the 23-year-old Uganda international is determined to lift silverware with the Edinburgh club. (RG via Daily Record, external)
Raith Rovers manager Dougie Imrie insists there is "no question" he will offer Lewis Stevenson a new contract if the 38-year-old former Hibernian left-back decides to play on next season. (The Courier, external)

Having already taken two players on loan from Bournemouth this season, Dundee technical manager David Longwell and managing director John Nelms travelled to the Premier League club this week to foster closer ties as they look to the January transfer market. (The Courier, external)
Legendary Celtic midfielder Paul McStay has revealed "it was a polite no thanks" when he was approached by someone on behalf of then Rangers manager Walter Smith to switch to their bitter rivals in 1992. (The Scotsman, external)
Former Rangers forward Fashion Sakala, who has become Al-Fayha's record all-time scorer in the Saudi Pro League, has made the surprising decision to retire from international duty with Zambia aged 29. (Scottish Sun, external)
Jake Sturgess, the 24-year-old Perth football coach who swapped Jeanfield Swifts for Juventus' Middle East talent centre, has been forced to cut short his new job after only two months having been diagnosed with cancer. (The Courier, external)
Former Rangers manager Russell Martin, now in charge of Leicester City, and Celtic-linked Robbie Keane are contenders for the Swansea City job after Vitor Matos left for French club Strasbourg. (The National, external)
Former Celtic manager Wilfried Nancy has been rejected for another job after missing out on the Strasbourg job following an interview. (The Herald, external)
Dunfermline Athletic head coach Neil Lennon has revealed he has given a statement to Police Scotland regarding allegations he was subjected to sectarian abuse during this month's Fife derby against Raith Rovers. (Scottish Sun, external)
Former Rangers striker Cyriel Dessers, the 31-year-old now with Panathinaikos, has revealed the biggest regret of his career is failing to win a league title with the Ibrox club. (The National, external)
Dunfermline Athletic's owners, Park Bench, have vowed to be "fiscally responsible and patient" with Bordeaux after buying the former French champions were demoted to the sixth-tier amateur Nouvelle Aquitaine Régional 1. (The Courier, external)

מועדוני פאר אירופיים ובהם מילאן, ריאל מדריד ומנצ'סטר יונייטד סומנו כגורמים המביעים עניין בקשר נאפולי ונבחרת סקוטלנד, סקוט מקטומינאי, כך לפי דיווחים בתקשורת. במקביל, עולם הכדורגל הסקוטי והבריטי רוחש ידיעות לקראת חלון ההעברות של חודש ינואר.

באשר לשחקנים נוספים, צ'לטיק עשויה לנסות ולצרף בעתיד את קשר אסטון וילה ג'ון מקגין אם יחליט לשוב למולדתו, בעוד ריינג'רס דחתה הצעות ענק על הקיצוני דז'יידי גאסאמה ואינה מתכוונת לשחררו בינואר. קבוצות נוספות כמו צ'לסי וניוקאסל יונייטד עוקבות מקרוב אחרי כישרונות צעירים, ומאמן דאנפרמליין אתלטיק ניל לנון אישר כי מסר עדות למשטרה בעקבות תלונות על התנהגות פסולה כלפיו במשחק ליגה.
